scope: New paired responses to 42 queries; A/B randomized independently per query; only blind-review-second-input.json read for response evidence
limitations: Provisional intent judgements, not human or production acceptance.
No model identities, mappings, logs, metrics or other results inspected.
No title-result lists or downstream attribute/concrete routing provided.
Soft required/excluded labels are not assumed to impose hard eligibility.
Related traits and obvious implications are allowed; terseness or label count is not rewarded by itself.
